name: Lake Skulker Moss
summary: In northern Lake Lordamere, Lake Skulker Moss draws the Royal Apothecary Society's attention. Apothecary Berard identified it as an organic part of research into brewing a New Plague before Arugal's curse claimed his mind.

sections.title: A Plague Reagent
sections.body: Lake Skulker Moss is gathered from Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers on the Dawning Isles. Before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard cataloged the plants and creatures of eastern Silverpine Forest. In his journal, he wrote that Lake Skulker and Lake Creeper mosses could stabilize or react with other ingredients. After Berard became Arugal's mindless servant, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village for Apothecary Renferrel. Renferrel sent Forsaken champions to gather moss and a rare tumor from local Vile Fin murlocs, then deliver both to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Lake Skulker Moss used for?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity uses Lake Skulker Moss as an organic base for brewing the New Plague, in pursuit of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's goals for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where does this moss come from?
faq.answer: Lake Skulker Moss is scraped from Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers in the waters around the Dawning Isles, in northeastern Lake Lordamere off Silverpine Forest.

Apothecary Berard identified the moss's potential while studying Silverpine Forest. After Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant, his journal helped Apothecary Renferrel and Master Apothecary Faranell continue the experiments.
Master Apothecary Faranell, leader of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity's Apothecarium, needs the moss for his biological warfare projects.

angles.text: As an Undead, you bring the Royal Apothecary Society closer to perfecting the New Plague, a weapon the Forsaken intend to use against the Scourge and the living.
